label: Pif system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an F-plasmid pif-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder Pif__PifA and Pif__PifC profiles and exemplified by the pif region that specifies abortive infection of T7 phage.
observations: Pif branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual pif genes, PifA or PifC proteins, the F plasmid, the DefenseFinder Pif__PifA or Pif__PifC HMM profiles, source database rows naming one Pif locus, T7-specific host-range outcomes, unresolved T7 triggers, and generic abortive infection systems.
